cli.finish.dev_reminder:
================ Final step: turn off Developer mode ================
Finishing does not mean every step succeeded — check the results first. If you are done troubleshooting or retrying, turn off Developer mode and USB debugging:
  · Some banking, payment, and game apps warn or refuse to run when USB debugging is on
  · With it off, nobody can connect to your phone from a computer just by plugging it in

Two ways, pick one:
  1) On the phone: Settings → search "Developer options" → turn off the main switch at the top
  2) On the computer: python3 tool/run.py -s {s} dev-off --yes
     (The computer will disconnect from the phone afterwards — that is normal)

Turning off Developer mode does not undo this session's changes: switches turned off, suspended packages, and silenced notifications all stay as they are.
To restore suspended packages later, turn Developer mode and USB debugging back on (see docs/00-打开开发者模式.md).
==========================================================

cli.help.chan:
Marketing notification channels (generic version, using the fast engine).
  chan_fast.py -s SERIAL scan             Read-only: list open channels whose names look like marketing (candidates for you to pick)
  chan_fast.py -s SERIAL verify list.tsv   Read-only: how many listed channels are still on
  chan_fast.py -s SERIAL off list.tsv      Open each channel page and turn it off
  chan_fast.py -s SERIAL on  list.tsv      Restore
list.tsv: package<TAB>channel id<TAB>note, one per line; lines starting with # are comments.
cli.help.fast:
Fast ad-removal engine (uiautomator2, screen reads in ~0.03 s).

Commands:
  fast.py -s SERIAL ls                 List the current screen: text + switch states
  fast.py -s SERIAL check              Check the screen reader service; taps nothing and prints no page content
  fast.py -s SERIAL tap text [text…]    Tap each in turn (scrolls to search if not found)
  fast.py -s SERIAL off [keep,…]       Turn off every on switch in the current list (titles matching keep words are left alone), scrolling to the bottom
  fast.py -s SERIAL scan                 Read-only: scroll to the bottom and list all switches
  fast.py -s SERIAL only word,word…     Only turn off switches whose titles contain these words
  fast.py -s SERIAL run model-script.py  Run one brand/model script
In a script: from fast import Phone
cli.help.run:
Phone ad removal · main entry. Every command needs -s <serial> (first column of adb devices).

  python3 tool/run.py devices                      List connected phones, model, system version, and whether a model script exists
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL check              Read-only: lock screen, model script match, ad-package suspend state
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL ui-check           Read-only: check the phone's screen reader service; taps nothing
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL backup             Pre-change snapshot, saved to backups/<model>-<time>/
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL recipe [section …] Run this model's model script (no section = run all)
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL chan-scan          Read-only: list open marketing notification channels → backups/.../channels.tsv
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL chan-off list.tsv   Turn off the channels in the list
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL chan-on  list.tsv   Restore them
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL suspend pkg …      Suspend ad packages (only with the owner's agreement); recorded in backups/.../suspended.txt
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL unsuspend [pkg …]  Lift suspension (no package = lift everything in the record)
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL quickapp           Read-only: detect quick app components (installed, suspended, running, used)
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL quickapp off       Turn off quick apps: suspend all quick app components (only with the owner's agreement)
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL quickapp on        Restore quick apps
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL finish             Finish: restore stay-awake-while-plugged-in to its backed-up value, remind to turn off Developer mode
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL dev-off --yes      Turn off Developer mode and USB debugging from the computer (the computer then disconnects from the phone)
  python3 tool/run.py -s SERIAL status-json        Read-only: print all status at once (JSON, for the GUI)

cli.troubleshooting.ui_recovery: If the screen reader connection fails, check whether GKD, auto bookkeeping, Appium, or similar tools are operating the phone automatically. Users have reported that pausing GKD and auto bookkeeping helped, but the exact app or pattern is not confirmed. Only pause automation / Shizuku screen-reading features you are sure you can pause; if needed, temporarily turn off that app's accessibility service yourself. Keep screen readers and accessibility services you rely on — do not turn off all accessibility features at once. Keep the phone unlocked and tap "Check screen reader connection" again; if it still fails, restart the phone manually and copy the full diagnosis. Restore any tools you paused afterwards.
cli.troubleshooting.xiaomi_input: On Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO, also turn on "USB debugging (security settings)" in Developer options (requires a SIM card and a signed-in Xiaomi account). Without it, the computer can read the screen but cannot tap or change settings, and you will see many "not found", "channel state did not change", and mid-run screen-lock errors.
